BMT notes that in my previous note, COPY-SEQUENCE is not the same
as the notion of COPY-TOP-LEVEL -- the latter would just be
   (MAPCAR #'(LAMBDA (X) X) <x>) 
on lists, and is the same as COPY1 on other sequences.
